milestone.title: Agent enablement docs + master-planner skill v2

intent.outcome: Agents have a fast, correct path from session start to plan-ready, with a skill that links to reference docs rather than duplicating them.

problem.description: Pilot section C + skill wishlist 1-10 + H4: missing BROWNFIELD-HANDOFF / AGENT-QUICKSTART / PLANNING-ONLY-MODE docs; the skill lacks a scope note, session decision tree, minimal validating JSON, gotchas box, error-code table, per-profile first-hour checklists, read-command table, and a stop-planning gate; `mp init` does not write a root AGENTS.md.

out_of_scope: turning the skill into a copy of MP-COMMANDS.md

acceptance_criteria.description: New docs exist: docs/BROWNFIELD-HANDOFF.md, docs/AGENT-QUICKSTART.md, docs/PLANNING-ONLY-MODE.md covering the pilot flows
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: docs index lists them; content covers handoff mapping, quickstart, and planning-only gate
acceptance_criteria.evidence: BROWNFIELD-HANDOFF.md, AGENT-QUICKSTART.md, PLANNING-ONLY-MODE.md created and indexed in docs/README.md

acceptance_criteria.description: Skill gains: an upfront workflow-vs-reference scope note; a session decision tree; a minimal validating milestone JSON; a maintained gotchas box (>=5 rows); an error-code table (B1/G3/SCH-01); per-profile first-hour checklists; a read-command table; a stop-planning gate
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: skill sections present; gotchas box has >=5 CLI-neq-docs rows [manual-auto-prefix: 2026-07-16]
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Skill v2: scope note, decision tree, read-command table, stop-planning gate, error-code table, gotchas box (6 rows), per-profile checklists, JSON example

acceptance_criteria.description: mp init --with-root-agents writes /AGENTS.md from the ROOT-AGENTS-SNIPPET template (pointer to the plan zone)
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: flag creates root AGENTS.md; without flag, repo root unchanged
acceptance_criteria.evidence: init_root_agents.rs tests pass: flag writes root AGENTS.md, omitted flag leaves root unchanged

work_packages.name: Enablement docs
work_packages.goal: Add the missing pilot-flow docs (handoff, quickstart, planning-only) and index them

work_packages.name: Skill v2 + init flag
work_packages.goal: Upgrade the master-planner skill to v2 and add mp init --with-root-agents

steps.tests: manual: docs index lists it; content covers the planning-only gate
steps.done_when: PLANNING-ONLY-MODE.md exists and is indexed, covering the planning-only gate

steps.action: Skill v2 - structure and navigation: add an upfront workflow-vs-reference scope note, a session decision tree, a read-command table, and a stop-planning gate
